mode: built-in image_gen; one call per head direction
user_directive: 这个耳朵太丑了，多提供几个头部参考；馆守z不用重做了，沿用现有的就行

directions.title: 中央独冠
directions.design: A compact teal helmet with ONE strong ivory center crest rising from the forehead bridge and sweeping backward into a short flattened blade. It has a gold recessed longitudinal channel and a blunted split trailing tip. The crest rises no more than about one third of the helmet height. Both temple sensor discs are flush and there are NO lateral upright horns. A single narrow amber visor lies in a deep graphite brow opening, above a broad continuous ivory lower faceplate. Show a decisive aerodynamic profile and clean central silhouette.
directions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an original HEAD DESIGN REFERENCE for Unbranded One, an athletic autonomous community-maintained martial-arts competition robot in Super GAG.
Input image is the current unapproved body/palette reference ONLY. Extract its drawing family and ivory / deep teal / ochre paint, not its bland helmet. Design a distinctive new head described below. The user REJECTED the previous pair of tall parallel ear-like fins; no rabbit-ear silhouette.
ONE head-and-upper-shoulder bust only, no duplicate heads, no full body. The face points about 20 degrees toward viewer's left, camera at eye level. Frame head including its crown with at least 12% margin at top and sides; include neck and a little of the unchanged broad ivory shoulder shells and teal upper chest. Head is large, not a tiny head on an oversized torso.
Materials: ivory and deep teal armor, ochre/gold accents on chosen crown or brow, charcoal inner structure, small amber sensor accents. Each part has believable thickness, mechanical mounting, crisp planes and a compact neck. Elegant mechanical face, expressive heroic brow, no human skin.
Style: current KINETIC_CEL, confident pressure-varying dark ink, clean large paint planes, one or two crisp hard cel shadows, restrained seams. No noisy engraving or excessive greebles; no photoreal PBR, plastic toy render or soft airbrush. This is a serious agile striking machine, not a mascot, animal or generic armored soldier.
Preserve individual palette and drawing quality. Avoid familiar branded head combinations, red chin block, paired cheek mouth vents, a forehead jewel and skinny classic antenna rods. V-shaped or branched crown forms ARE allowed when they are original and well integrated. No emblem or legal-clearance claim.
Actual transparent background, no floor, shadow, glow halo, labels, typography, numbers, arrows, diagram insets or watermark. One square composition.

directions.title: 低位V冠
directions.design: A short WIDE ochre and ivory V-shaped brow crown mounted LOW across the front of the teal helmet. Its two broad tapered ends extend outward and slightly upward from the brow, at roughly 20 degrees above horizontal, never vertically from the ears. Thick flat chamfered blades rather than skinny aerials; crown width is at most 1.6 helmet widths and tips stay below the top of the helmet. Small central open notch, ivory swept cheek panels, deep graphite optical recess with a continuous narrow amber visor. Strong heroic V silhouette without the familiar thin antenna / humanoid mouth-vent head combination.

directions.title: 重眉面甲
directions.design: An assertive compact MARTIAL-ARTS face with a heavy stepped ivory brow bridge and two short layered cheek guards that sweep back BELOW the temples. No long protruding horn or ear fin. The forehead is a prominent angular teal trapezoid with a gold inset bridge; it slopes into the heavy brow so the head still has a strong signature silhouette. TWO separate narrow amber optical shapes under the brow, an intact broad ivory chin guard with dark lateral hinge joints, smooth closed faceplate without mouth vents. Boxing-headgear mass and a fierce calm face, sophisticated robot rather than a human helmet.

directions.title: 三齿短冠
directions.design: An original SHORT THREE-TOOTH crown integrated into one broad ivory forehead plate: a stout central trapezoid tooth and two lower splayed shoulder teeth, with two deep notches making the three teeth clear. Shallow fan shape spanning the forehead, ochre recessed inner edges, teal rear helmet. It rises no more than a quarter helmet height and is thick manufactured aero/impact armor, not a thin royal ornament, spikes or animal ears. Compact temple housings. Two sharp amber optics in one dark band and a layered but closed ivory faceplate. Confident heroic character without medieval decoration.

directions.title: 单侧折角
directions.design: An ASYMMETRIC original head. The side facing the viewer has ONE short ivory and gold folded-angle blade mounted above and behind the temple; it projects backward in a shallow lightning-like angular profile with an open triangular cutout. The opposite side has a flush dark sensor puck and a small ivory service plate, no second raised horn. A compact segmented teal helmet with an off-center white brow ridge, one continuous amber visor and an ivory wedge faceplate. Purposeful balanced design with one repaired connector indicating cooperative modification, no ragged damage. Neither a tall rabbit ear nor a huge radio aerial; total fin tip stays close to the head.

directions.title: 后掠翼冠
directions.design: An original LOW REAR-SWEPT crown: two short broad ivory triangular wing plates originate at the REAR upper cranium and sweep backward-out almost horizontally, like a compact aerodynamic crest. Their outer tips extend only a little beyond the skull, with ochre inner edges and a short teal central keel. They are clearly rearward planar blades rather than two tall ears; the helmet top remains low and rounded-angular. Strong angular ivory brow with a dark continuous narrow amber visor, streamlined teal cheek recesses and closed ivory lower faceplate. Fast, alert, sophisticated mechanical athlete, not a bird head or animal mask.
